source_context: Bulk sandbox historical replay evidence pilot v0.2. Synthetic seed evidence for attribution-learning pipeline testing; not production evidence.
evidence_items: Singapore Manufacturing Capacity output in 2022 was influenced by capacity expansion and production ramp-up activity.
A new plant, new facility, higher capacity, and capacity addition affected production levels.
Investment activity and ramp up conditions shaped output movements.
Production increased as facilities came online and operational capacity improved.
